headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats. The New York Yankees also secured a win, taking down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season. The Washington Nationals and San Diego Padres also secured victories, with Cade Cavalli and Randy Vásquez earning the wins for their respective teams.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Freddy Fermin (San Diego Padres) due to a concussion, José Ramírez (Cleveland Guardians) with a left hamate fracture, Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals) with a right hamate fracture, Evan Carter (Texas Rangers) with a right oblique strain, Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates) with a right lat muscle strain, Jack Flaherty (Detroit Tigers) with a left peroneal strain, Miguel Andujar (San Diego Padres) with a left hamstring strain, and Trent Grisham (New York Yankees) with a right hamstring strain.

The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for Future Considerations, while the Chicago White Sox traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Milwaukee Brewers traded RHP Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 6 H. Samad Taylor led the Padres' offense with 3 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI in 5 AB.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a convincing 8-3 win over the Seattle Mariners, with Cade Cavalli earning the victory. Colt Emerson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out by Guardians in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 0-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, marking a hard-fought win for the Guardians. Jack Flaherty, a pitcher for the Tigers, took the loss in the game.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Freddy Fermin on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres catcher Freddy Fermin has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Guardians Make Roster Move Ahead of Trade Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians have traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations.
